consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]

visualizations.]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open

## The gold standard in safety excellence

At Advanced Technology Services, safety is more than a priority—it’s a core value embedded in our
culture. To put this value into action, we launched the [Beyond Zero program][64], a proactive
commitment to employee well-being and safety. Beyond Zero goes beyond aiming for zero incidents; it
drives continuous improvement and fosters a culture of holistic care, ensuring our people feel
supported, protected, and empowered—both on and off the job.

Our organization-wide commitment to safety excellence has led to:
* Awarded the Robert W. Campbell Safety Award—the pinnacle for safety excellence
* On average, we maintain a 50% lower recordable incident rate than industry standard
* Featured in Safety+Health magazine’s “CEOs Who ‘Get It'”

[Learn more about safety][65]
[img]

## Coverage wherever you operate

ATS provides industrial maintenance services across the U.S., the U.K. and Mexico, supporting
manufacturers of any size. Backed by decades of experience and a standardized reliability
methodology, we provide support across single-site and multi-site operations. Our skilled
technicians bring field‑proven expertise, consistent service standards and a safety-first mindset to
every site. We manage all travel logistics to ensure dependable support at any location. Choosing
ATS as your industrial maintenance provider means you can benefit from our:
* Proven support for facilities of all sizes and locations
* Scalable operations for growing and multi-site organizations 
* On-site embedded workforce model
* Technology-driven approach to reliability

types of production equipment and the adaptability to flex our skillsets for any industry.

Selecting KPI 

KPIs give a clear view of the machinery’s performance and possibilities for development. We define
the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) vital to analyzing each machine or process’s cost, OEE,
productivity, and efficiency. We discover the exact number of data points required for each KPI.

### Automatic Data Capture 

Identifying the KPIs that require data, we either choose new sensors that are appropriate or make
use of the ones that are already in place. Sensors are in charge of collecting data from the
machinery in real-time. Collect the unprocessed data from the sensors and process it initially near
the network's edge, close to the data source.

### Data Processing

A central server or cloud infrastructure receives the data that the Edge IIoT Gateway for Industry
has processed and transfers it securely. High-speed, secure transmission protocols are employed to
guarantee the integrity of the data and prevent breaches or corruption while it is in transit. Our
high-speed transmission helps to avoid data breaches or corruption.

### Visualization 

We build accurate graphs and visually appealing dashboards. These smart devices support performance
tracking and pinpoint areas in need of development. Managers and operators can view dashboards on
the production floor, allowing them access to real-time updates.

## About Us

**BMS controls** was formed in 2006 for the purpose of supplying building management systems
services to theatre land premises via mechanical and electrical companies throughout the **UK**.
From these grassroots the company has carried out mainly BMS projects with **maintenance** contracts
being awarded from the completion of each contract. Our success in the industry has brought us to
the attention of many companies wishing to use our services, especially in the BMS controls sector.
We have invested heavily in our future and expanded our business to various markets such as
commercial, retail government etc, with great success. It is from this that we have created our
specialist **controls** division.

As a BMS Specialist company we employ experienced software, project and maintenance engineers that

project to ensure a consistently good service.

### 

Our engineering teamwork to your requirements producing a co-ordinated information package enabling

engineers

Our electrical installation teams provide complete supervision of the power. control and network
installation., fully complying with the regulations of the Institute of Electrical Engineers. We
commission control loops using calibrated test equipment to match the plant response.

### Motor Control Centre Manufacture
### 

We manufacture motor control centers to Form 2, 3, and 4 using brand name components. These are
assembled and wired within the enclosures to previously prepared and approved design. Following
completion, we thoroughly test each MCC with each circuit connected to a simulation test rig.

## What you worry about, solved

### 01. Can’t find the exact sensor match?

Many trucks share the same engine but use different sensors by year or connector, so easy to order
the wrong part.
Send us your VIN + old-part photos, and our engineers will match OE numbers, connector type and
length before we quote and ship, cutting wrong deliveries and returns.

[ Contact Us ][11]

### 02. Not sure about goods quality?

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

### 03. How do you secure shipping?

We keep safety stock on core SKUs, so most orders ship within 24–48 hours.
courier/air/sea options and full tracking with lead-time commitment help you avoid stock gaps and
costly downtime.

[ Contact Us ][13]

## WHY CHOOSE US

[ Predictable supply for wholesale programs ][14]

Multi-warehouse strategy in China with rolling safety stock on core SKUs. Weekly capacity planning
ensures stable availability during peaks. 

[ Cross-border logistics you can plan around ][15]

Consolidated shipping, export documents ready (commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes), and
carrier options for air/sea. Clear lead-time tiers: 5 days ex-works, 7-15 days door-to-door to
EU/LatAm hubs.

[ Total landed cost advantage without quality trade-offs ][16]

Tiered pricing for volume, fixed packing specs, and optimized cartons to reduce dimensional weight.
Batch-level traceability keeps warranty risk low.

[ Quality you can trace, warranty you can rely on ][17]

Two-stage QC (inbound/outbound), serialized labels, and retained samples by lot. Warranty terms
aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

[ VIN and photo-matching that reduces returns ][18]

Fast model/connector verification before purchase via VIN and old-part photos. (48h confirmation
window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

[ Compliance and documentation ready for customs ][19]

IATF 16949 processes, RoHS material declarations, IP ratings where applicable, MSDS and test reports
available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

Multiple trade terms (EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP by arrangement), payment options (T/T, L/C for qualified
partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

Installation guides, failure analysis reports within 3 business days, and RMA portal designed for
batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

## What you worry about, solved

### 01. Can’t find the exact sensor match?

Many trucks share the same engine but use different sensors by year or connector, so easy to order
the wrong part.
Send us your VIN + old-part photos, and our engineers will match OE numbers, connector type and
length before we quote and ship, cutting wrong deliveries and returns.

[ Contact Us ][11]

### 02. Not sure about goods quality?

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

### 03. How do you secure shipping?

We keep safety stock on core SKUs, so most orders ship within 24–48 hours.
courier/air/sea options and full tracking with lead-time commitment help you avoid stock gaps and
costly downtime.

[ Contact Us ][13]

## WHY CHOOSE US

[ Predictable supply for wholesale programs ][14]

Multi-warehouse strategy in China with rolling safety stock on core SKUs. Weekly capacity planning
ensures stable availability during peaks. 

[ Cross-border logistics you can plan around ][15]

Consolidated shipping, export documents ready (commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes), and
carrier options for air/sea. Clear lead-time tiers: 5 days ex-works, 7-15 days door-to-door to
EU/LatAm hubs.

[ Total landed cost advantage without quality trade-offs ][16]

Tiered pricing for volume, fixed packing specs, and optimized cartons to reduce dimensional weight.
Batch-level traceability keeps warranty risk low.

[ Quality you can trace, warranty you can rely on ][17]

Two-stage QC (inbound/outbound), serialized labels, and retained samples by lot. Warranty terms
aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

[ VIN and photo-matching that reduces returns ][18]

Fast model/connector verification before purchase via VIN and old-part photos. (48h confirmation
window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

[ Compliance and documentation ready for customs ][19]

IATF 16949 processes, RoHS material declarations, IP ratings where applicable, MSDS and test reports
available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

Multiple trade terms (EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP by arrangement), payment options (T/T, L/C for qualified
partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

Installation guides, failure analysis reports within 3 business days, and RMA portal designed for
batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

Depth Technology Limited, headquartered in Hong Kong, is a specialized manufacturer and exporter of
high-quality truck components, with a strong focus on precision sensors for heavy-duty vehicles.
Leveraging robust production capabilities and a global outlook, we serve clients across
international markets.

Core Business

Our core business centers on the manufacturing and export of truck parts, especially sensors (e.g.,
Map sensor and Maf sensor). We supply a full range of components—from engine systems to chassis
parts—tailored for brands like Sinotruk, Shacman, and FAW. Our products are exported to regions
including Russia, Southeast Asia,Middle East, Africa, and Europe.

# Leading Smart Thermostat OEM/ODM Manufacturer with 20+ Years Experience

## **Your Global Expert in Smart HVAC & IoT Control**

 

**Who is E-TOP?**

Founded in 2003, E-top is a premier ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified manufacturer with
over 20 years of dedicated expertise in the thermostat industry. Operating from an 8,000 m²
professional facility, we specialize in [high-end ODM/OEM solutions][96] for global heating and
cooling markets. Our mission is to combine innovation with passion to create a smarter, sustainable
"Green World" through precision climate control.

[E-top professional thermostat factory with SMT production lines, R&D lab, and QC testing
facilities]

 

 

**Our Manufacturing & R&D Power**

We provide a full-chain manufacturing service, including SMT, Plug-in, Injection, Silk Printing,
Assembly, and rigorous Aging Tests.

**Production Capacity: **5,000+ units per day with a 95%+ on-time delivery rate.

**[Professional R&D][97]: **Supported by a 20-member R&D team, we utilize advanced tools like FMEA,
APQP, and PPAP to ensure world-class product development.

 

**Connectivity Leadership:**

We are at the forefront of IoT integration, supporting:

**Smart Ecosystems: **Official integration with Tuya Smart, Smart Life, Amazon Alexa, and Google
Assistant, and Matter.

**Industrial Protocols: **BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and OpenTherm.

**Wireless **Standards: Zigbee, LoRaWAN, RF (433/868/915MHz), and Bluetooth.

**App Support: **Seamless mobile control via App Store and Google Play applications.

 

 

**World-Class Quality & Certifications**

Quality is our signature. Every E-top thermostat undergoes a complete IQC/IPQC/FQC process in our
professional validation lab. To ensure global market access and user safety, our products are
rigorously tested and carry the world's most recognized safety marks:

**Global Compliance: **TUV, ETL, CE (LVD, EMC, RED), UKCA, and [**EU CRA (Cyber Resilience
Act)**][98]

**Environmental Standards: **RoHS and REACH

**Trusted Partners Worldwide**

Our long-term commitment to quality has made us the trusted manufacturing partner for global
industry giants, including:

Carrier, Bosch, Daikin, Danfoss, Viessmann, Belimo, Johnson Controls, Watts, Meross, and more.

* 05 2026.06
  [Lifting Giants: Why the Eurocrane 400T Overhead Crane is a Game-Changer for Transformer
  Manufacturing][194]
  In the world of electrical grid infrastructure, transformer manufacturing represents the pinnacle
  of heavy industrial engineering. As global demand for high-voltage direct current (HVDC) and
  ultra-high-voltage (UHV) power transmission grows, transformers are becoming larger, denser, and
  significantly heavier. Moving a fully assembled transformer tank or handling active parts weighing
  hundreds of tons leaves zero room for error. That is why Eurocrane has engineered the 400T/50t
  Overhead Crane—a heavy-duty lifting masterpiece specifically designed to address the unique
  challenges of the transformer manufacturing sector.   1. Precision Handling for Delicate
  Components While a transformer is a metal giant, its internal core, windings, and insulation
  structures are highly delicate. Any violent oscillation or sudden jerk during the positioning
  phase can cause catastrophic structural damage. Eurocrane’s 400T crane utilizes advanced frequency
  inversion and intelligent anti-sway technology. This ensures millimeter-level micro-speed control,
  allowing operators to smoothly lift, rotate, and lower core assemblies into the vacuum drying
  ovens or transformer tanks with absolute precision.

  [Lifting Giants: Why the Eurocrane 400T Overhead Crane is a Game-Changer for Transformer
  Manufacturing][194]
  In the world of electrical grid infrastructure, transformer manufacturing represents the pinnacle
  of heavy industrial engineering. As global demand for high-voltage direct current (HVDC) and
  ultra-high-voltage (UHV) power transmission grows, transformers are becoming larger, denser, and
  significantly heavier. Moving a fully assembled transformer tank or handling active parts weighing
  hundreds of tons leaves zero room for error. That is why Eurocrane has engineered the 400T/50t
  Overhead Crane—a heavy-duty lifting masterpiece specifically designed to address the unique
  challenges of the transformer manufacturing sector.   1. Precision Handling for Delicate
  Components While a transformer is a metal giant, its internal core, windings, and insulation
  structures are highly delicate. Any violent oscillation or sudden jerk during the positioning
  phase can cause catastrophic structural damage. Eurocrane’s 400T crane utilizes advanced frequency
  inversion and intelligent anti-sway technology. This ensures millimeter-level micro-speed control,
  allowing operators to smoothly lift, rotate, and lower core assemblies into the vacuum drying
  ovens or transformer tanks with absolute precision.

## *application***Industry Application**

Our products come in a wide variety and are applied in numerous fields.

### External rotary subtype motor

As a leading manufacturer specializing in the research and development of external rotor motor
production equipment, Gimech, with its meticulous craftsmanship and cutting-edge technology, creates
high-performance external rotor motor production equipment. 

[ Learn More ][135]
[index-bg6]

## *application***Industry Application**

Our products come in a wide variety and are applied in numerous fields.

### Electric tool motors (brushed, brushless)

China's power tool products are mainly exported, with the main export destinations concentrated in
North America, Europe and other regions. 

[ Learn More ][136]
[index-bg3]

## *application***Industry Application**

Our products come in a wide variety and are applied in numerous fields.

### Smart home and medical devices motor

In recent years, driven by intelligent and automated high technologies, the smart home industry has
entered a period of rapid development. According to the deployment of relevant ministries and
commissions in our country, over 500 cities in China have begun or are currently building smart
cities to promote the development of smart cities and the arrangements of local governments.

[ Learn More ][137]
[index-bg5]

## *application***Industry Application**

Our products come in a wide variety and are applied in numerous fields.

### Industrial motors

Gimech specializes in the manufacturing equipment such as robot-specific motors, axial motors, and
servo motors. From precision robot joint drive motors to the precise control of heavy industrial
motor production equipment, Gimech empowers industrial upgrading with solid technology and
interprets the power of intelligent manufacturing with outstanding quality.

[ Learn More ][138]
[index-bg1]

## *application***Industry Application**

Our products come in a wide variety and are applied in numerous fields.

### Household appliances motor

Gimech started with series-excited motors and has over twenty years of mature experience. Its
products cover a wide range of home appliance fields. For example: motor automation equipment such
as compressors (refrigerators, air conditioners), vacuum cleaners, washing machines, fans,
dishwashers, etc.

[ Learn More ][139]
[index-bg2]

## *application***Industry Application**

Our products come in a wide variety and are applied in numerous fields.

### Full range of vehicle-mounted motors

Gimech has been dedicated to the automotive motor industry for many years. Its products cover
vehicle-mounted motors and it has the production capacity of complete lines of equipment including
rotors, stators, and assembly lines.

[ Learn More ][140]

Мониторинга транспорта как платформа помогает решить две ключевых задачи: контроль и аналитика.

* Модуль уведомления о прохождении ТО.
* Интеграция топливных карт для автоматической сверки заправок.
* Автоматическое заполнение путевых листов.
* Объединение с внешними CRM системами и 1С.
* Сервис уведомлений о нарушениях и работе датчиков.

# Strait of Hormuz Live Shipping Tracker

Real-time monitoring dashboard for the Strait of Hormuz crisis. The Strait of Hormuz was briefly
reopened on April 21, 2026, but closed again on April 22, 2026.

## Current Status

The strait is currently CLOSED. Commercial shipping suspended after brief reopening.

## Key Metrics
* Ships transiting: Near zero (normal: ~60/day)
* Stranded vessels: 150+ ships including tankers, bulk carriers, and other commercial vessels
* Oil prices: Brent crude surging due to supply disruption
* War risk insurance: Premiums at extreme levels, over 16x normal rates
* Throughput: Under 2% of normal daily deadweight tonnage

## Global Trade Impact

Approximately 21% of the world's oil supply and 25% of global LNG trade is at risk. Countries most
critically affected include South Korea and Japan, with high impact on India, China, and the
European Union. The estimated daily economic cost exceeds $4 billion.

## Supply Chain & Alternative Routes

Ships are rerouting via the Cape of Good Hope, adding up to 14 extra transit days and significantly
increasing shipping costs. Tanker spot rates have tripled for Gulf-to-Asia routes. The US Strategic
Petroleum Reserve provides a buffer, but prolonged disruption threatens global consumer prices.

## Crisis Timeline

Track key events in the Hormuz crisis including military escalations, diplomatic efforts, economic
impacts, and de-escalation attempts. Events are displayed chronologically with severity indicators.

## Peace Talks

Monitor the latest diplomatic developments and peace negotiations regarding the Strait of Hormuz
crisis.

## About This Dashboard

This dashboard provides real-time data on the Strait of Hormuz shipping crisis, including ship
transit counts, Brent crude oil prices, stranded vessel counts, war risk insurance premiums, daily
throughput, global trade impact analysis, crisis timeline, and peace talk status. Data is updated
hourly from multiple sources.

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems
* Monitoring of 10800+ technological parameters 24/7 in real-time

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems
* Monitoring of 10800+ technological parameters 24/7 in real-time

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

# Explore Our Devices

### product gallery

[
[Solar Bluetooth Gateway]

### GATEWAY

Combine and harness the power of Bluetooth®, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT/LTE-M, Cat-1, UWB, Bluetooth AoA to
build a robust and reliable middle point between the end devices and the network server of your
tracking system.

][139]
[
[Container Tracker]

### TRACKER

The devices that monitor and record the location or status of any objects or personnel, providing
real-time or historical data for any of your tracking purposes.

][140]
[
[Bluetooth Beacon][Bluetooth Beacon]

### BEACON

Compact, low-energy devices that broadcast signals via Bluetooth, to enable the precise location
tracking of nearby objects or assets.

][141]
[
[Lora Temperature And Humidity Sensor][Lora Temperature And Humidity Sensor]

### SENSOR

Get reliable data for the surrounding environment, such as temperature, humidity, or air quality,
using the long-range, low-power LoRaWAN technology.

][142]

## Unveiling Advanced IoT Tracking Solutions

Whether you need indoor or outdoor tracking, asset and personnel monitoring, advanced contact
tracking, Bluetooth data transfer or control, we've got you covered. Efficiently manage and
safeguard your valuable assets and personnel. Our tracking technology ensures you have a precise
view of asset locations and the well-being of your workforce, promoting safety and productivity
while minimizing costs.

[ View Our Solutions > ][143]

# Applications

### IoT Solutions for Different Scenarios

[Shipping-Containers-Gps-Tracking][Shipping-Containers-Gps-Tracking]

### Shipping Container Tracking

Location tracking at sea is a challenge on its own because it is a harsh environment for the
propagation of radio waves as well as limited infrastructure, maritime regulations, and many more.
[ Discover > ][144]
[Smart Catlle Tracking][Smart Catlle Tracking]

### Smart Cattle Tracking

Modern ranching operations face several critical challenges that impact productivity, animal
welfare, and operational costs. These challenges are particularly acute in regions with harsh
climates and limited water resources.
[ Discover > ][145]
[Construction Site Worker Tracking][Construction Site Worker Tracking]

### Construction Site Worker Tracking

Industrial workplaces such as construction sites, factories, and warehouses often expose workers to
risks. Ensuring worker safety while maintaining productivity is a critical challenge.
[ Discover > ][146]
[ View All Cases > ][147]

# About Lansitec

### Partner with Lansitec

### Focus on Quality

Our expertise lies in designing and manufacturing hardware for communication, networking, sensing,
and algorithm implementation to complement our clients' skill sets for successful projects. We stay
focused on providing quality [products][148] utilizing cutting-edge technologies and industry
knowledge.

### More Than a Client

It is great to win a project, but an opportunity that can be multiplied is more valuable. We
consider each client a partner with whom not only can we help to grow, but more importantly, we can
grow together on technology, business, and of course, revenue. We also provide training and
whitepapers for you to learn the related knowledge.

[Customized Logo][Customized Logo]

## Customization Services

Lansitec’s customization services are designed to ensure the success of our clients and their
customers. We are dedicated to providing tailored [solutions][149] that address specific needs. Our
services include:

· Feature and firmware development
· Product prototype verification
· Housing and tooling design
· Certification services
· Design for manufacturing
· Customized accessories featuring client branding

## Access to a free demo application platform

### To expedite the product to market and PoC, we provide the free web-based platform for clients to
### test and demo the products. (like Thingsboard and TagoIO, etc.)

The platform mainly supports the following functions for your reference:

1. Show the device on the map.
2. Import and manage tracking devices, and personnel information.
3. Configure devices, such as heartbeat and report intervals.
4. Manage Bluetooth beacon location configuration.
5. Manage system functions: authorization management, password management, personnel management,
etc.
6. Various kinds of data statistics analysis, quantity, and location of the current device or
current type of device.
7. History traces can be filtered by time.
8. Geo-fence, set up and delete alert information.
9. Provide an API port to be used by third-party tools.

[Thingsboard Demo][Thingsboard Demo]

### Focus on Quality

Our expertise lies in designing and manufacturing hardware for communication, networking, sensing,
and algorithm implementation to complement our clients' skill sets for successful projects. We stay
focused on providing quality [products][148] utilizing cutting-edge technologies and industry

It is great to win a project, but an opportunity that can be multiplied is more valuable. We
consider each client a partner with whom not only can we help to grow, but more importantly, we can
grow together on technology, business, and of course, revenue. We also provide training and

Lansitec’s customization services are designed to ensure the success of our clients and their
customers. We are dedicated to providing tailored [solutions][149] that address specific needs. Our
services include:

1. Show the device on the map.
2. Import and manage tracking devices, and personnel information.

4. Manage Bluetooth beacon location configuration.
5. Manage system functions: authorization management, password management, personnel management,
etc.
6. Various kinds of data statistics analysis, quantity, and location of the current device or
current type of device.
7. History traces can be filtered by time.
8. Geo-fence, set up and delete alert information.
9. Provide an API port to be used by third-party tools.

## **Welcome to Monitra (formerly HVPD). **

**Founded in 2006 with headquarters in the UK and locations around the world, we have developed
cutting edge high voltage partial discharge monitoring and testing technology to ensure your high
voltage networks are safe and reliable, avoiding dangerous and costly unplanned outages.**


At Monitra, we supply a comprehensive range of equipment suitable for the condition assessment of
in-service Medium Voltage (MV), High Voltage
(HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) power cables, switchgear, transformers, generators and motors
including Variable/Frequency Drives.

## Introducing Atlas by Monitra™

# Atlas by Monitra™

## The transformational cloud-based data management platform

**Our new flagship platform. **Monitor plant and asset condition, benchmark health rankings,
generate reports, and receive recommended maintenance priorities from anywhere in the world.

[Explore Atlas by Monitra™][8]

## For any help or inquiries about how we can help you, call us on [+1 (281) 524 7480][9] or
## complete our online inquiry form

## **What is Partial Discharge?**

High voltage partial discharge is a degenerative phenomenon that affects the electrical insulation
of medium voltage and high voltage equipment.

### **Partial discharge monitoring**

[PD monitoring][10] provides the best early warning indicator of electrical degradation in high and
medium voltage assets.

### **Condition-based maintenance**

PD testing and monitoring supports condition-based maintenance programmes, enabling operators to
improve their asset reliability and avoid unplanned outages.

### **Outage prevention**

By providing a condition assessment of in-service assets, Monitra helps operators avoid in-service
failures, reduce unplanned outages and improve their maintenance efficiency - saving them time and
money.

## FAQ

How does the Propel app work?

Propel connects to your state's portal with your permission. Then, Propel gathers your EBT balance
and transaction history, makes it easier to read, and displays it in the app.

This means you don't need to call a 1-800 number or log in to a state website.
The app also helps you manage your benefits with:
* **Deposit predictions**, so you know when your next payment is coming
* **Clear transaction details**, including store names and online purchases
* **Security features**, like fraud monitoring and out-of-state transaction blocking

Is the Propel app free?

Yes! The Propel app is completely free to use.

Does the Propel app work in all states?

The Propel app offers balance checking in 49 states, the District of Columbia, and several U.S.
territories, including Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Guam.

Balance checking is currently not available in Iowa.

How does the Propel app make money?

We make money through advertising, but we’re selective about what we promote.

Most offers are free or discounted services only available to EBT cardholders—like free phones,
discounted internet, and grocery savings at major retailers.

What else does the Propel app offer?

The Propel app is more than just balance checking—here are some of our additional features:
* EBT security features, like suspicious activity monitoring & out of state transaction blocking
* Easy-to-understand updates about changes to policy or benefits programs, so you’re always in the
  loop
* Exclusive offers & discounts on groceries, utilities, and phone & internet bills
* Job & gig opportunities that fit your schedule

## Trusted by Those Who Wear It

The RingConn Gen 2 represents this simplicity by blending sophisticated health monitoring with an
elegant design, focusing on the metrics that matter most.
[ [RinConn user information]][41]
When the dentist asked for the report of my husband's SpO2, which he forgot to bring, I showed him
the recorded monitoring in the RC2 app. The dentist was very impressed... and agreed that the oral
device was appropriate (to treat his sleep apnea).
[ [RinConn user information]Marni S.][42]
I had a pretty significant motorbike accident... The ring documented what was most likely a large
drop of blood pressure/shock and then the HR jump when the pain was starting to be realized by my
body... my ring is still showing my progress from that logged event. It’s really encouraging to see
my progress daily.

Baby room monitoring

Greenhouse tracking

## Check Room Temperature Online

RoomTemperature.io lets you check room temperature online using connected smartphones and smart
monitoring devices. Thousands of users use our platform to view live room temperature readings,
monitor indoor conditions, and access temperature history from anywhere in the world.

If you are searching for room temperature check online, online room temperature check, or current
room temperature online, our live monitoring platform provides a simple way to view indoor
temperature information without needing expensive hardware or complicated setup.

The live temperature displayed above is updated from real devices connected to our monitoring
network. This allows visitors to view current room temperature data and understand indoor
environmental conditions in real time.

## Live Room Temperature Monitor

A live room temperature monitor helps users track indoor temperature remotely. Whether you need to
monitor a bedroom, baby room, greenhouse, pet enclosure, office, warehouse, or server room, live
temperature tracking provides instant access to environmental conditions.

With RoomTemperature.io, temperature readings can be viewed from virtually anywhere with an internet
connection. Users can monitor changes over time and review historical temperature graphs using the
companion mobile application.

## Room Temperature Measurement Online

Many people search for room temperature measurement online, room temperature meter online, or room
temperature detector online when they need a quick estimate of indoor conditions. Online monitoring
tools can provide useful insights into environmental temperature trends and help users maintain
comfortable indoor spaces.

Temperature monitoring is useful for homes, offices, data centers, laboratories, storage rooms, and
agricultural environments where maintaining a stable temperature is important.

## Check Room Temperature With Your Phone

Many users ask how to check room temperature with a phone online. Modern smartphones can be used as
connected monitoring devices, allowing temperature information to be uploaded and viewed through a
secure dashboard. This enables remote monitoring without constantly being near the device.

Our Room Temperature Thermometer application makes it possible to view live temperature data, access
historical records, and monitor conditions from anywhere. This is particularly useful when
travelling or monitoring locations remotely.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I check room temperature online for free?

Yes. RoomTemperature.io provides free access to live room temperature monitoring and historical
temperature tracking.

### My Room Temperature Online

You can view live temperature readings from connected devices and monitor room conditions remotely.

Smartphones can assist with temperature monitoring depending on device capabilities and
environmental conditions.

RoomTemperature.io is a room temperature monitoring platform that helps users track indoor
environmental conditions from anywhere. By using smartphones as connected monitoring devices, users
can access live room temperature information through a simple online dashboard.

Our platform is designed for homes, baby rooms, offices, server rooms, greenhouses, pet enclosures,
storage areas, and other indoor spaces where temperature awareness is important.

In addition to temperature monitoring tools, RoomTemperature.io publishes educational resources
about room temperature, indoor comfort, humidity, sleeping temperature recommendations, nursery
temperature guidelines, and online temperature measurement methods.

Our goal is to make temperature monitoring accessible, easy to understand, and available to anyone
with an internet connection.

About Sunlite Systems

## Delivering Premium AV & IT Solutions with Over a Decade of Excellence

[Sunlite Systems Pvt. Ltd.][144] is a leading importer, distributor, wholesaler, retailer, and
system integrator of high-quality Audio Visual (AV), IT hardware, and networking solutions.
Established in 2012, we have built a strong reputation across India and international markets
including Asia, Middle East, and beyond as a trusted partner for advanced technology needs.

Under the leadership of Directors Mr. Shainki Bansal (Rohit) and Mr. Jatin Goyal, our experienced
team with 14+ years of expertise specializes in complete AV and IT solutions. We offer conferencing
systems, commercial displays, video walls, enterprise networking products, surveillance solutions,
and reliable IT infrastructure. As an authorized dealer for top global brands like Samsung, LG,
Panasonic, HP, Dell, Lenovo, Cisco, Poly, Logitech, and many more, we focus on genuine products,
competitive pricing, timely delivery, and excellent after-sales support.

Whether you need digital signage, audio video conferencing setups, home theatre systems,
indoor/outdoor LED displays, meeting room solutions, or classroom technology, Sunlite Systems
delivers end-to-end services for government, corporate, education, and defense sectors. As a
registered government supplier, we help clients across Delhi NCR, Andhra Pradesh, and Pan India with
seamless procurement and installation.

# Industrial **Solutions** for a **Sustainable** Future.

TMEIC is a global leader in industrial systems and solutions. We leverage our combined expertise to
drive innovation and efficiency across various sectors worldwide.

### Renewable Energy

As the creator of the world’s first 1000kW photovoltaic inverter, TMEIC’s development team has long
been a solutions innovator in alternative energy systems.

[ Learn more ][79]

### Crane systems and port technology

TMEIC is a leader in advanced control and automation technology for ports and terminals worldwide.

[ Learn more ][80]

### Carbon Neutrality

TMEIC provides diverse solutions to realize carbon neutrality. – Contributing to society with
exceptional technology and partnering with our customers –

[ Learn more ][81]

### Metals

TMEIC’s Industrial Systems engineers are the leading force in ferrous and nonferrous metals
production around the world and have been for more than 50 years.

[ Learn more ][82]

## Driving Industry **Forward:** the TMEIC Advantage

The [TMEIC 21-H Series motor][83] is a high-performance industrial motor that serves multiple
sectors including conveyors, metals, marine propulsion, mining, rubber and plastics, utility plants,
and water applications.

TMEIC drives industry around the world through a comprehensive offering of unique systems solutions
including variable frequency drives, motors, photovoltaic inverters and advanced automation systems
for a wide range of industrial applications.

TMEIC is a global leader in industrial systems and solutions. We leverage our combined expertise to
drive innovation and efficiency across various sectors worldwide.

### Renewable Energy

As the creator of the world’s first 1000kW photovoltaic inverter, TMEIC’s development team has long
been a solutions innovator in alternative energy systems.

[ Learn more ][79]

### Crane systems and port technology

TMEIC is a leader in advanced control and automation technology for ports and terminals worldwide.

[ Learn more ][80]

### Carbon Neutrality

TMEIC provides diverse solutions to realize carbon neutrality. – Contributing to society with
exceptional technology and partnering with our customers –

[ Learn more ][81]

### Metals

TMEIC’s Industrial Systems engineers are the leading force in ferrous and nonferrous metals
production around the world and have been for more than 50 years.

[ Learn more ][82]

The [TMEIC 21-H Series motor][83] is a high-performance industrial motor that serves multiple
sectors including conveyors, metals, marine propulsion, mining, rubber and plastics, utility plants,
and water applications.

TMEIC drives industry around the world through a comprehensive offering of unique systems solutions
including variable frequency drives, motors, photovoltaic inverters and advanced automation systems
for a wide range of industrial applications.

##### Frequently Asked Questions

## Common questions about UpKeep CMMS software.

Quick answers on what a CMMS is, what makes UpKeep different from other maintenance management
platforms, and how AI changes day-to-day maintenance work.

What is a CMMS?

A CMMS, or computerized maintenance management system, is software that centralizes work orders,
preventive maintenance schedules, asset records, parts inventory, and technician activity in one
system. CMMS platforms replace spreadsheets and paper logs and give maintenance teams real-time
visibility into the health of their equipment. Modern CMMS software also includes mobile access,
integrations with ERP and IoT sensors, and AI-driven automation.

What's the difference between a CMMS and an EAM?

A CMMS focuses on day-to-day maintenance operations: work orders, preventive maintenance, technician
scheduling, and parts inventory. An enterprise asset management (EAM) system covers the full asset
lifecycle, including procurement, capital planning, depreciation, and end-of-life. Most modern
platforms, including UpKeep, blend CMMS and EAM capabilities so one system can run frontline
maintenance work and longer-term reliability strategy.

What is asset operations management?

Asset operations management is the practice of running maintenance, safety, reliability, and asset
data on one connected platform rather than in separate systems. It extends traditional CMMS by
adding IoT sensor data, environment health and safety reporting, fleet maintenance, and analytics.
The goal is fewer silos between teams, better visibility into asset health, and faster response when
equipment changes condition or fails.

What is the UpKeep platform?

UpKeep is an asset operations platform built around a mobile-first CMMS (computerized maintenance
management system). Teams use it to create and track work orders, schedule preventive maintenance,
and manage asset history across every site. The platform also includes UpKeep Safety for EHS
compliance, UpKeep Learn for training built from your own procedures, Edge sensors that monitor
equipment condition, and Nova, an AI assistant that creates work orders, builds custom apps, and
flags issues on its own. Over 4,000 companies use UpKeep to reduce downtime, extend asset life, and
keep teams safe.

How does AI improve a CMMS?

AI in a modern CMMS automates work that used to require manual effort. Sensor data triggers work
orders before equipment fails. Schedules adjust automatically based on technician availability and
asset criticality. Safety incidents convert into preventive actions without rekeying data. UpKeep's
AI, called Nova, generates work orders from real-time data, surfaces patterns across thousands of
assets, and recommends actions before small issues become unplanned downtime.

What's included in UpKeep?

UpKeep's core Maintenance product is a full CMMS that includes work order management, preventive
maintenance scheduling, asset tracking, parts and inventory, mobile access for technicians, and
AI-driven automation through Nova. UpKeep also offers separate products that run on the same
platform: EHS for safety reporting, Fleet for vehicle maintenance, Edge for IoT condition
monitoring, LMS for frontline learning, and Studio for building no-code custom apps. All products
share one data foundation, one set of permissions, and one mobile experience.

How is UpKeep different from other CMMS platforms?

UpKeep is the AI-native CMMS and asset operations platform. Three things set it apart from CMMS
alternatives like Limble, MaintainX, and Fiix. First, the platform extends beyond core CMMS into
safety, fleet, IoT sensors, learning, and a service provider marketplace, so teams can run more of
asset operations from one system. Second, AI is foundational to the product rather than a feature
add-on. Third, the mobile experience is built for technicians working in the field, not office
users.


What companies use UpKeep?

More than 4,000 companies use UpKeep, including Unilever, Chevron, Caterpillar, and McDonald's.
UpKeep customers span manufacturing, energy, food service, fleet operations, education, healthcare,
and multi-site facilities management. The platform supports both single-site teams getting off paper
and spreadsheets for the first time and global enterprises managing thousands of assets across
hundreds of locations.

How much does UpKeep cost?

UpKeep pricing starts at $24 per user per month for the core Maintenance product, which includes
work order management, preventive maintenance, asset tracking, mobile access, and Nova AI. Higher
tiers add advanced features like multi-site management, integrations, custom analytics, and single
sign-on. UpKeep also offers separate products for safety reporting (EHS), fleet maintenance, IoT
condition monitoring (Edge), and frontline learning (LMS). All plans include a free trial with no
credit card required.

compliance, UpKeep Learn for training built from your own procedures, Edge sensors that monitor
equipment condition, and Nova, an AI assistant that creates work orders, builds custom apps, and
flags issues on its own. Over 4,000 companies use UpKeep to reduce downtime, extend asset life, and
keep teams safe.

How does AI improve a CMMS?

AI in a modern CMMS automates work that used to require manual effort. Sensor data triggers work
orders before equipment fails. Schedules adjust automatically based on technician availability and
asset criticality. Safety incidents convert into preventive actions without rekeying data. UpKeep's
AI, called Nova, generates work orders from real-time data, surfaces patterns across thousands of
assets, and recommends actions before small issues become unplanned downtime.

What's included in UpKeep?

UpKeep's core Maintenance product is a full CMMS that includes work order management, preventive
maintenance scheduling, asset tracking, parts and inventory, mobile access for technicians, and
AI-driven automation through Nova. UpKeep also offers separate products that run on the same
platform: EHS for safety reporting, Fleet for vehicle maintenance, Edge for IoT condition
monitoring, LMS for frontline learning, and Studio for building no-code custom apps. All products
share one data foundation, one set of permissions, and one mobile experience.

How is UpKeep different from other CMMS platforms?

UpKeep is the AI-native CMMS and asset operations platform. Three things set it apart from CMMS
alternatives like Limble, MaintainX, and Fiix. First, the platform extends beyond core CMMS into
safety, fleet, IoT sensors, learning, and a service provider marketplace, so teams can run more of
asset operations from one system. Second, AI is foundational to the product rather than a feature
add-on. Third, the mobile experience is built for technicians working in the field, not office
users.


What companies use UpKeep?

More than 4,000 companies use UpKeep, including Unilever, Chevron, Caterpillar, and McDonald's.
UpKeep customers span manufacturing, energy, food service, fleet operations, education, healthcare,
and multi-site facilities management. The platform supports both single-site teams getting off paper
and spreadsheets for the first time and global enterprises managing thousands of assets across
hundreds of locations.

How much does UpKeep cost?

UpKeep pricing starts at $24 per user per month for the core Maintenance product, which includes
work order management, preventive maintenance, asset tracking, mobile access, and Nova AI. Higher
tiers add advanced features like multi-site management, integrations, custom analytics, and single
sign-on. UpKeep also offers separate products for safety reporting (EHS), fleet maintenance, IoT
condition monitoring (Edge), and frontline learning (LMS). All plans include a free trial with no
credit card required.

## Frequently asked questions.

### What is UptimeRobot?

UptimeRobot is an uptime monitoring service that continuously checks [websites, APIs, and other
endpoint][114]s. It alerts you when anything goes down, degrades, or changes. So you can stay on top
of your systems' current states and identify issues before your users do.

UptimeRobot also provides tools to transparently communicate the [real-time status][115] and
reliability of your systems, and proactively [manage incidents][116] when they happen.

### What is an uptime monitor?

An uptime monitor is a single tool that repeatedly verifies a target webpage or service is online
and working as expected.

When an uptime monitor detects a problem, it instantly sends [alerts][117] (via email, SMS/IM, call,
etc.) so you can respond quickly. It also records incidents with timestamps and details in your
dashboard so that you can track reliability over time.

Uptime monitors support various [monitoring types][118] (HTTP, Ping, Port, Keyword, DNS, Heartbeat),
targets (URL/IP/Port), and alerting rules (including escalation).

### How do I monitor the uptime of a website?
1. [Sign up][119] to create a free UptimeRobot account
2. In the dashboard, click Add New Monitor
3. Choose HTTP(S) as the monitor type and enter the website URL
4. Set the monitoring interval and any optional settings you care about (timeouts, redirects,
   keyword checks)
5. Add your preferred notification channels (email, push, Slack, SMS, etc.) and save the monitor
6. Optionally: [create a status page][120]

### How do I create a status page?
1. [Sign up][121] and create a free UptimeRobot account
2. [Create your first monitor][122] (so there's something to display)
3. Go to Status Pages and click Create Status Page
4. Select the monitors (or tags) you want to show, then name the page
5. Publish your status page
6. Optionally: customize the design, set a custom domain, password-protect it, opt out of search
   engine indexing, and use announcements for incident/maintenance updates (users can subscribe with
   email right on your status page).

### What can I monitor with UptimeRobot?

With UptimeRobot, you can monitor any website, API, server, application, service, [network][123], or
endpoint, whether it’s yours, a third-party vendor’s, or a dependency you rely on. Additionally,
UptimeRobots supports these monitor types:
* HTTP/HTTPS
* [Keywords][124] in server responses and on-page
* [Ping][125]
* [Port][126]
* [Cron jobs/heartbeats][127]
* [Website change detection][128]
* [Response time][129]
* [DNS changes][130]
* [SSL certificates][131] and [domain expiry][132]

The variety of monitor types lets you track availability, response behavior, certificates, scheduled
jobs, and infrastructure changes from one place.

### How often does UptimeRobot check my website?

UptimeRobot can check your site and other endpoints as often as every 30 seconds and as infrequently
as every 5 minutes, depending on your monitor's settings. The available [monitoring
intervals][133] in your account also depend on your plan:
* Free: every 5 minutes
* Solo/Team: every 60 seconds
* Enterprise: every 30 seconds

Faster intervals improve time-to-detect, but can create more noise if your endpoint is flaky or the
network is unstable.

### Can I monitor from multiple locations/regions?

Yes, UptimeRobots supports [location-specific monitoring][134]. With multi-location checks, you can
spot regional outages, routing problems, or CDN edge issues that won't show up from a single vantage
point. It's especially useful for DNS and security scenarios where failures can first appear in one
location

### How do I get an alert when a website is down (by email, SMS/IM, or phone)?

Add one or more notification channels and associate them with your monitors. The available personal
channels include Email, SMS, Voice Call, Mobile App Push, and Email-to-SMS; and
the [integrations][135] include [Telegram][136], [Slack][137], [Microsoft
Teams][138], [Discord][139], [Google Chat][140], Mattermost, [PagerDuty][141], Splunk
On-Call, [Pushbullet][142], and [Pushover][143]. For custom workflows, you can also
use [Webhooks][144], [Zapier][145], [MCP][146], or [API][147].

### How does UptimeRobot reduce false alarms (false positives)?

UptimeRobot reduces false alarms by rechecking failures across multiple checker nodes and locations
before opening an incident. You can further improve signal-to-noise by white-listing

## Frequently asked questions.

### What is UptimeRobot?

UptimeRobot is an uptime monitoring service that continuously checks [websites, APIs, and other
endpoint][114]s. It alerts you when anything goes down, degrades, or changes. So you can stay on top
of your systems' current states and identify issues before your users do.

UptimeRobot also provides tools to transparently communicate the [real-time status][115] and
reliability of your systems, and proactively [manage incidents][116] when they happen.

### What is an uptime monitor?

An uptime monitor is a single tool that repeatedly verifies a target webpage or service is online
and working as expected.

When an uptime monitor detects a problem, it instantly sends [alerts][117] (via email, SMS/IM, call,
etc.) so you can respond quickly. It also records incidents with timestamps and details in your
dashboard so that you can track reliability over time.

Uptime monitors support various [monitoring types][118] (HTTP, Ping, Port, Keyword, DNS, Heartbeat),
targets (URL/IP/Port), and alerting rules (including escalation).

### How do I monitor the uptime of a website?
1. [Sign up][119] to create a free UptimeRobot account
2. In the dashboard, click Add New Monitor
3. Choose HTTP(S) as the monitor type and enter the website URL
4. Set the monitoring interval and any optional settings you care about (timeouts, redirects,
   keyword checks)
5. Add your preferred notification channels (email, push, Slack, SMS, etc.) and save the monitor
6. Optionally: [create a status page][120]

### How do I create a status page?
1. [Sign up][121] and create a free UptimeRobot account
2. [Create your first monitor][122] (so there's something to display)
3. Go to Status Pages and click Create Status Page
4. Select the monitors (or tags) you want to show, then name the page
5. Publish your status page
6. Optionally: customize the design, set a custom domain, password-protect it, opt out of search
   engine indexing, and use announcements for incident/maintenance updates (users can subscribe with
   email right on your status page).

### What can I monitor with UptimeRobot?

With UptimeRobot, you can monitor any website, API, server, application, service, [network][123], or
endpoint, whether it’s yours, a third-party vendor’s, or a dependency you rely on. Additionally,
UptimeRobots supports these monitor types:
* HTTP/HTTPS
* [Keywords][124] in server responses and on-page
* [Ping][125]
* [Port][126]
* [Cron jobs/heartbeats][127]
* [Website change detection][128]
* [Response time][129]
* [DNS changes][130]
* [SSL certificates][131] and [domain expiry][132]

The variety of monitor types lets you track availability, response behavior, certificates, scheduled
jobs, and infrastructure changes from one place.

### How often does UptimeRobot check my website?

UptimeRobot can check your site and other endpoints as often as every 30 seconds and as infrequently
as every 5 minutes, depending on your monitor's settings. The available [monitoring
intervals][133] in your account also depend on your plan:
* Free: every 5 minutes
* Solo/Team: every 60 seconds
* Enterprise: every 30 seconds

Faster intervals improve time-to-detect, but can create more noise if your endpoint is flaky or the
network is unstable.

### Can I monitor from multiple locations/regions?

Yes, UptimeRobots supports [location-specific monitoring][134]. With multi-location checks, you can
spot regional outages, routing problems, or CDN edge issues that won't show up from a single vantage
point. It's especially useful for DNS and security scenarios where failures can first appear in one
location

### How do I get an alert when a website is down (by email, SMS/IM, or phone)?

Add one or more notification channels and associate them with your monitors. The available personal
channels include Email, SMS, Voice Call, Mobile App Push, and Email-to-SMS; and
the [integrations][135] include [Telegram][136], [Slack][137], [Microsoft
Teams][138], [Discord][139], [Google Chat][140], Mattermost, [PagerDuty][141], Splunk
On-Call, [Pushbullet][142], and [Pushover][143]. For custom workflows, you can also
use [Webhooks][144], [Zapier][145], [MCP][146], or [API][147].

### How does UptimeRobot reduce false alarms (false positives)?

UptimeRobot reduces false alarms by rechecking failures across multiple checker nodes and locations
before opening an incident. You can further improve signal-to-noise by white-listing
